२०२६ विश्वकपको उपस्थिति करिब कति पुगेको अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय फुटबल संघ महासंघ (Fédération Internationale de Football Association—FIFA) ले जनाएको छ?

questions.question: Spectrum को पहिलो commercial orbital launch मा कति साना satellites बोकिएको थियो?
GRAMMY Awards आयोजना गर्ने संस्थाको नाम के हो?

अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय फुटबल संघ महासंघ (Fédération Internationale de Football Association—FIFA)
संयुक्त राष्ट्र शैक्षिक, वैज्ञानिक तथा सांस्कृतिक संगठन (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization—UNESCO)

Which letter is 5th to the right of the 11th letter from the left in the alphabet?
questions.solution: 11th is K; five places right is P.

Scarcity : Resource :: Ambiguity : ?
Find the next number: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.solution: The terms are n(n+1); the sixth is 6×7=42.

'Install a backup system before migrating the database.' Assumptions: I Migration can involve data risk. II Every backup system is free.
questions.solution: Migration risk is relevant; cost is not implied.

questions.solution: चार दिशाको चक्र दोहोरिन्छ; अर्को तेर्सो।

Which comes next?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Each direction appears twice before rotating 90° clockwise; after ↓↓ comes ←.

questions.question: What is 25% of 240?
A completes a task in 15 days and B in 10 days. If they work together for 3 days, what fraction remains?
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Combined rate = 1/6; in 3 days they do 1/2, so 1/2 remains.

questions.question: Find the next number: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?.
questions.solution: Correct answer: D. Each term is divided by 3.

questions.question: A car travels 150 km in 3 hours. Its average speed is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: B. Speed = distance/time = 150/3 = 50 km/h.

questions.question: The simple interest on Rs. 5,000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is:
If A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5, then A:C is:
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Make B common: A:B=8:12 and B:C=12:15, so A:C=8:15.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A meeting must include exactly three of four topics A, B, C and D. A cannot be together with C. B must be included if D is included. Which set is possible?
questions.solution: A,B,D satisfies the A-C restriction and includes B whenever D is present.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A public transport operator changed routes without consulting traffic data. Afterward, congestion increased at several intersections. Which explanation is most logically plausible?
options: Traffic data can never predict congestion
The route change proves every intersection was affected
Congestion is unrelated to transport routes
The route change may have shifted traffic into already constrained intersections
questions.solution: A route change can redistribute traffic; the other statements are unsupported absolutes.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: The school should provide a digital copy of the timetable to parents. Assumptions: I. Parents may need convenient access to the timetable. II. Every parent owns a smartphone.
questions.solution: Convenient access is a reasonable implicit basis. Universal smartphone ownership is not required by the recommendation.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Six books P, Q, R, S, T and U are arranged left to right. P is left of Q. R is immediately right of S. T is between Q and U. Which arrangement is possible?
options: Q P T U S R
P T Q U S R
P Q U T S R
P Q T U S R
questions.solution: P-Q-T-U-S-R satisfies P before Q, R immediately after S, and T between Q and U.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: Before expanding the scholarship program nationwide, the authority should evaluate the pilot. Assumptions: I. Pilot results can provide evidence relevant to expansion. II. The pilot and nationwide program must be identical in every respect.
questions.solution: Evaluation assumes pilot evidence can inform the decision. Identical conditions everywhere are not necessary.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An agency's emergency procurement records show repeated missing justifications. Which course is most appropriate first?
options: Review the cases, identify the control failure, and require documented justification
Ignore the issue because emergencies are unpredictable
questions.solution: A targeted review can identify the weakness and lead to corrective controls without abandoning necessary emergency procurement.

Highest percentage population growth?

questions.question: Annual income from Bonds + Fund?
Smallest absolute increase?
North's fraction of 2025 total?

questions.passage: Large firms often have records, assets and borrowing histories that help lenders assess risk. Young firms may lack collateral and financial history. Better credit information and risk tools can reduce this information gap.
questions.question: Which statement is NOT supported?
options: Large firms may be easier to assess
Young firms can have good ideas
questions.solution: The passage describes uncertainty rather than perfect knowledge.

questions.passage: Meaningful community participation requires accessible information, enough time and a genuine opportunity to influence decisions. Residents can provide local knowledge, while feedback shows how their suggestions were considered.
questions.question: What does the passage imply about meetings?
options: Meetings alone do not prove participation
questions.solution: A meeting alone does not ensure meaningful participation.

questions.passage: Good leadership includes priorities, communication and safe reporting of problems. Fear can cause employees to hide mistakes. Constructive accountability keeps responsibility while encouraging learning and correction.
questions.question: Which statement is FALSE?
questions.solution: The passage does not argue that consequences should disappear.

questions.passage: Budgets allocate limited resources among competing priorities. Spending more on one programme can constrain another, although productive investment may create future benefits. Opportunity cost is the alternative use of funds that is forgone.
questions.question: Why is not every budget decision zero-sum?
options: Some investments can create future benefits
questions.solution: Productive investment may create future benefits.

questions.passage: Putting a paper form online does not ensure good digital service. Users also need clear instructions, accessibility, privacy, mobile usability and reliable support. Success means completing a task accurately with reasonable effort.
questions.question: Which statement is TRUE?
questions.solution: Clear instructions are explicitly identified as necessary.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “permanent”.
Choose the word opposite in meaning to “hostile”.
Choose the word closest in meaning to “resilient”.
questions.solution: “able to recover” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “mitigate”.
questions.solution: “lessen” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the correct noun form of “resilient”.
questions.solution: “resilience” is the correct derived form required by the sentence.

questions.question: A medicine or treatment used to prevent disease is
Choose the correct word: The researcher must _____ the original source in the article.
questions.solution: “cite” is the verb meaning to refer to a source as evidence or authority.

questions.question: This time next month, they ___ the new bridge.
questions.solution: A completed action expected before a future point takes the future perfect.

questions.question: Choose the sentence without a dangling modifier.
options: After reviewing the file, the officer noticed the error.
After reviewing the file, the error became obvious.
After reviewing the file, the error was noticed.
After reviewing, the file showed the error.
questions.solution: The officer is the person who reviewed the file, so the modifier is correctly attached.

questions.question: Choose the active form: 'The report was prepared by the analyst.'
options: The analyst was preparing by the report.
The analyst has prepare the report.
questions.solution: The agent analyst becomes the active subject.

questions.question: The report is concise, accurate and ___.
questions.solution: Adjectival coordination requires a parallel adjective phrase.

questions.question: The evidence was incomplete; ___, the committee postponed its decision.
questions.solution: Therefore expresses the result: because the evidence was incomplete, the decision was postponed.

questions.question: Each of the proposals ___ carefully examined before approval.
questions.solution: Each is singular and therefore takes was.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The committee approved the plan.'
options: The plan was approved by the committee.
The plan is approved the committee.
The committee was approved by the plan.
questions.solution: The object becomes the passive subject: The plan was approved by the committee.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: Although he was tired, he continued working.
Although he was tired, but he continued working.
Although tired, but he continued working.
Although he tired, but continued working.
questions.solution: Although already introduces the contrast, so but is unnecessary.
